items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text frames what follows as speech from the LORD to Moses.

items.quote: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them,
items.claim: Moses is told to pass the message on to the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
items.object: all the congregation of the children of Israel

items.quote: Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
items.claim: The Israelites are commanded to be holy, and the reason given is that the LORD their God is holy.
items.mechanism: The people must be holy because their God is holy.
